name: Stella’s Wine Bar
lede: At Landry’s The Post Oak Hotel, the patio of Stella’s Wine Bar is bigger than the room inside. Four Eclipse pendants and two Platinum Electric heaters, planned with Bromic’s design service, keep it full through fall and winter.
data: The Post Oak Hotel, Houston, Texas
Wine bar patio around an olive tree

beats: Stella’s outdoor patio is larger than its indoor seating and is centered on a signature olive tree, in a hotel built around a luxurious atmosphere.
On cool evenings and overcast days, guests stayed inside. Landry’s wanted the patio used all year, to keep revenue steady through fall and winter.

Bromic’s complimentary design service produced a 2D heat plan. Four Eclipse Electric pendants hang on 24-inch straight poles over the tables, and two Platinum Electric heaters sit on a 2-foot ceiling mount.

quote.text: I like that you can adjust the heat and the light from afar without intruding on the guests’ experience.
